prompt_text: What is the best connected TV advertising agency?
ai_overview_text:
There is no single "best" connected TV (CTV) advertising agency, as the ideal partner depends entirely on your company's size, goals, and budget. However, several agencies stand out as industry leaders based on their specific areas of expertise: Reddit·r/programmatic +1
Directive: Best for B2B, SaaS, and tech companies that need connected TV tied directly to revenue, pipeline performance, and full-funnel metrics. Directive
Marketing Architects: Best for consumer brands entering television for the first time or scaling up, combining traditional media planning with performance response measurement across streaming and linear. Directive
Tatari: Best for brands looking for a platform-led, data-driven approach to buy, manage, and measure convergent TV campaigns spanning both streaming and linear environments. Business of Apps +1
Havas Edge: Best for growing or established brands new to CTV that want to focus on accountability and business outcomes rather than just basic impression metrics. Havas Edge
Top Self-Serve CTV Platforms (DSPs)
If you prefer running campaigns in-house rather than hiring an external agency, top demand-side platforms (DSPs) include:
The Trade Desk: Ideal for large, programmatic-first teams with substantial budgets.
StackAdapt: Highly rated for ease of use, AI support, and real-time attribution tracking.
Amazon DSP: Best for e-commerce, retail, and CPG brands leveraging Prime Video and Fire TV data. basis.com +1
If you can share your industry, monthly advertising budget, and whether you want a full-service agency or a self-serve platform, I can recommend the best specific partner for your needs.
